name: http-client
description: Send HTTP requests from .http files (the VS Code REST Client and JetBrains format, with {{variables}} and environments) and see status, timing, headers and a JSON tree of the response. Requests go out from the Perch server, so localhost is your dev server even from a phone. Copy as curl, paste a curl command, and Open in HTTP Client on any listening port.

httpClient.timeoutSeconds.description: How long (seconds) a request may take before it's stopped.
